correctness.rationale: Reconstructed both two-year compositions explicitly and verified equation (1) by direct fraction subtraction. The derivative of the quadratic saturating recycling curve is strictly unimodal, establishing the unique maximum of its positive moving divided difference. Strict monotonicity and surjectivity of the lake update on nonnegative stocks transfers the two-root criterion to initial states. For the rational witness, the two sign inequalities and the three fixed-point derivatives are exact rational identities. The standalone script executed 3000 independent direct-versus-formula checks and high-precision bisection; these finite checks were not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The novelty claim is confined to the precise pair-order terminal-state identity and its two-positive-initial-stock reversal criterion, not the pre-existing lake map or lake hysteresis. Search and material comparisons of open-access 1999 original lake-model papers found model formulation, ecological management and simulation, not the explicit two-period divided-difference/crossing theorem. Semantic database searches for loading-order reversal and two thresholds returned distinct fishery, chemostat and ecological claims; no inspected result implies this exact classification. A 1999 foundational management article is abstract-only and general scalar-flow comparison results may be stronger; these are recorded as risks, not denied.
residual_risks: The most relevant 1999 Carpenter–Ludwig–Brock article was readable only as abstract; no negative claim is made about its full mathematical content.
A broad two-step input-order comparison for generic sigmoidal maps could subsume the mathematical core even without identifying this lake-specific threshold.

The 1998 working-paper antecedent is recorded bibliographically with year precision but its original exact-day release was not verified; the recorded first-public date is the earliest verified exact-day publication among the cited papers, not absolute origin of the model.
Numerical thresholds are approximations; only the analytic level-set theorem and exact sign inequalities establish existence and uniqueness.

value.rationale: The terminal effect of front-loading versus back-loading a fixed phosphorus budget is a natural management counterfactual; the model is a foundational bistable ecological recurrence. The theorem gives a complete, sharp and parameter-computable phase diagram for two rather than one initial-stock crossover, disproving any universal initial-state-independent ranking of the same two annual loads. A fully rational witness simultaneously has two stable lake states; this is a structural explanation of schedule ambiguity, not an arbitrary table digit, simulation-only observation, or generic textbook inequality.
